title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kpatch-patch-5_14_0-687_10_1 and kpatch-patch-5_14_0-687_42_1 security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for kernel live patch modules kpatch-patch-5_14_0-687_10_1 and kpatch-patch-5_14_0-687_42_1 targeting kernel version 5.14.0-687.10.1.el9_8. The update addresses four security vulnerabilities: validation of dacloffset in SMB client (CVE-2026-46195), limiting IPC next_id allocation (CVE-2026-52923), fixing a potential use-after-free in UDP tunnel segmentation (CVE-2026-74705), and bounding receive headroom in the TUN network driver (CVE-2026-81000). These fixes are important for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 variants on x86_64 and ppc64le architectures. The advisory rates the update as important and provides instructions for applying the patches.
